Note: please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud will be updated after the stable release; nightly-supported models may not be included yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: c4nd3, place the person from image 1 exactly as she is into the bedroom from image 2. Keep her face, hair, outfit and body completely identical. Do not change anything about her appearance. She is a blonde woman with long blonde waves darker at the roots, hazel eyes, fair skin with realistic makeup, soft feminine facial features. The bedroom from image 2 must remain exactly as it appears — same walls, same furniture, same floor, same ceiling, same lighting, do not add or remove anything from the room. She is standing naturally in the centre of the room at a natural distance from the camera, her full body from head to toe including feet is visible, she appears the correct scale relative to the room and furniture around her — she should look like a real person standing in the room, not oversized or too close to the camera. She is approximately 5 foot 7. Natural soft shadows fall realistically on the floor beneath her feet, lighting and shadows on her body match the warm ambient bedroom light completely. Photorealistic iPhone photo, vertical framing, full length portrait.

Upscale the image in high definition, restore realistic skin texture, remove plastic looking skin, skin should look washed and clean and not dirty and do not add moles, do not add freckles unless present on the image, preserve moles from the image if present but do not add new moles, keep the entire image content unchanged.
